posts.title: Forma: how heavy will it be? (extra)
posts.note: di 1/12 · extra Forma-post van die week
posts.igCaption:
How heavy will it be? Will the neck dip?

Sixto Forma tells you before a single piece of wood is cut. Draw your guitar and it works out the weight, how it hangs on a strap, how it sits on your leg and how far up the neck your hand gets.

Too heavy? Tap Chambered: hollow wings inside, the top stays closed. This one got about 0.3 kg lighter, same shape, same look.

New: save your design as a link and open it again any time.

Free, in your browser, on your phone too. Link in bio. Like what you made? Send it to me and we talk about building it, by hand, one of a kind.

How heavy is your favourite guitar?

#SixtoCustomGuitars #CustomGuitar #GuitarDesign #Luthier #HandmadeGuitar

I love shaping a neck by hand, with a spokeshave and a Shinto rasp. But a fixed starting point makes the process more uniform, and a bit quicker. So now a bit carves the back of the neck first, and I take it from there.

posts.title: Tignum: neck overhaul (prototype)
posts.igCaption:
Tignum is a prototype, and its neck is getting an overhaul.

The wood I used for the fretboard turned out not to be dense enough for a fretboard. I only found out once the frets were in. Epoxy coating didn't do much. Superglue, coated and wicked into the wood, did a lot more.

All that coating left a mess between the frets, so I designed and printed mini sanding cauls to clean it up.

Then the fun part: a believable relic. Rolled fretboard edges for that played-in feel, the headstock matched to the body with a heavy relic I practised first, and a white stinger on the back.

Not done yet. Prototypes are where I try things, so a customer build only gets what has proven itself.

#SixtoCustomGuitars #HandmadeGuitar #Luthier #Prototype #GuitarNeck

posts.title: Forma: why do the tuners sit there? (extra)
posts.note: za 28/11, tussen de postdagen. Zonder geluid: muziek in de app. v2 (19/11): vier echte koppen in kleur (zwaan vervangen door spits: snaren kruisten).
posts.igCaption:
Why do the tuners sit right there?

Builders aim for a straight string pull: the string runs as straight as possible from the nut to the tuner post. Less friction at the nut, so the string stays in tune better.

It's a goal, not a law. On a Les Paul the strings bend about 7° at the nut.

In Sixto Forma you draw the head, and the tuners place themselves. Whatever the shape.

Which of your guitars stays in tune best?

#SixtoCustomGuitars #HandmadeGuitar #Luthier #GuitarDesign #Headstock
